2.text: “Uzahereza he kuvuga utyo?Kandi uzagarukiriza he kuvuga amagambo ameze nk'umuyaga wa serwakira?

3.text: Mbese Imana igoreka urubanza?Ishoborabyose igoreka gukiranuka?

4.text: Niba abana bawe bayicumuyeho,Ikabatanga mu maboko y'ibibi byabo,

6.text: Iyaba wari uboneye kandi ugakiranuka,Ni ukuri byatuma iguhugukira,Igatuma ishyira ihirwe mu kibanza cyawe hakiranutse.

7.text: Nubwo itangira ryawe ryari rito,Ariko amaherezo yawe wakunguka cyane.

8.text: “Ndakwinginze baza ab'ibihe bya kera,Kandi wite ku byo ba se bashimikiraga.

9.text: Erega turi ab'ejo gusa kandi nta cyo tuzi,Kuko iminsi tumara mu isi ari igicucu gusa.

10.text: Mbese abo ntibazakwigisha bakagutekerereza,Bakavuga amagambo bakuye mu mitima yabo?

11.text: Urufunzo rwakurira ahadatose?Cyangwa se urukangaga rwamera ahatari amazi?

12.text: Iyo rukiri rubisi rutaracibwa,Rubanziriza ibyatsi byose kuma.

13.text: Ni ko inzira z'abibagirwa Imana bose zimeze,Kandi ibyiringiro by'uhakana Imana bizashira.

14.text: Kwizigira kwe kuzahera,Ibyiringiro bye ni urutagangurwa.

15.text: Yakwegamira inzu ye ariko ntiyahagarara,Yayikomerezaho ariko ntiyagumaho.

16.text: “Atoshye ari ku zuba,Amashami ye asagambira mu murima we.

17.text: Imizi ye iraranda mu kirundo,Ishorera mu nzu yubakishijwe amabuye.

18.text: Nakurwe aho yari ari,Hazamwihakana hati ‘Sinigeze kukubona.’

19.text: Dore uwo ni wo munezero w'imigenzereze ye,Kandi ku butaka hazashibuka abandi.

20.text: “Dore Imana ntizata umuntu w'intungane,Kandi ntizaramira inkozi z'ibibi.

21.text: Akanwa kawe izakuzuza ibitwenge,N'iminwa yawe izavuza impundu.

22.text: Abakwanga bazambikwa isoni,Kandi ihema ry'inkozi z'ibibi ntirizongera kubaho.”
